architecture.description: L1 CamemBERT routes to L1 class. Then: xgboost classes use existing XGBoost models. camembert_setfit classes use CamemBERT L2 flat for common subcats, SetFit fallback for rare subcats (when CamemBERT predicts rare or low confidence). generative classes use LLM fallback.
inference_flow: 1. L1 CamemBERT → predicted L1 class + confidence
2. If L1 confidence < threshold → generative fallback
3. If L1 class in xgboost bucket → XGBoost predict
4. If L1 class in camembert_setfit bucket → CamemBERT L2 predict
4a. If CamemBERT predicts a common subcat with high confidence → accept
4b. If CamemBERT predicts a rare subcat OR low confidence → SetFit predict over rare subcats
